outcome: Type 1 diabetes during childhood or adolescence
cohort: All children diagnosed with type 1 diabetes from 2000 to 2012 (n = 9,376) from the Swedish paediatric quality register, matched with four controls by year, day of birth, sex, and county of birth from the Swedish Medical Birth Register.
finding: Caesarean section had no influence on the risk of developing type 1 diabetes during childhood or adolescence.
mod_finding: Children of mothers without diabetes, delivered by CS, had no increased risk of developing type 1 diabetes.
